status_vocabulary.UNVERIFIED: no image observation; observation null; confidence NONE
status_vocabulary.CANDIDATE: one reviewer, full provenance block, every rejection condition checked and none triggered
status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: CANDIDATE plus >= 2 contiguous supporting frames, independent second reviewer who agrees, confidence MODERATE or HIGH

review_state: NO_IMAGE_REVIEW_PERFORMED: the original NLM files were unreachable from the cloud session (egress 403)
hard_constraints: Source skeleton governs geometry; this register never moves or reshapes it.
No c005; c004 unchanged; canonical readiness unchanged.
The donor is one cadaver, not a canonical 182 cm male.
Scanner RAS is not the Home Gym PT world frame; no transform applied.
Stored PNG values are not verified Hounsfield units; no density threshold is a bone definition.
3 mm slices are not sub-millimetre surfaces; coordinates carry the conservative envelope.
Image laterality must be established from an anatomical cue, never from the header or file order.

landmarks.name: Left iliac blade (ala) cross-section
landmarks.what_would_be_labelled: Curved plate of cortical-bounded cancellous bone lateral to the sacrum in axial section
rejection_conditions: R0: laterality cue absent, or the cue (a recognisable right/left-asymmetric organ or marker) contradicts the side recorded
R1: outline or boundary depends on one display window; it must remain stable across at least two different stored-value windows (stored values are not verified HU)
R2: structure is inconsistent between adjacent 3 mm frames (appears, vanishes or changes shape discontinuously) beyond what its anatomy allows
R3: not mirrored by a comparable plate on the contralateral side within 15 mm in scanner S, unless the pelvis is clearly asymmetric (record why)
required_to_promote: observation block with every field in OBS_REQUIRED
atlas figure cross-check recorded in atlas_crosscheck
every rejection condition checked and none triggered
landmarks.coverage_needed_for_3d_surface: Contiguous 3 mm run from the iliac crest to the acetabular roof (pelvic height 152 +/- 17 mm, range 99-185 mm in Musielak 2019): about 35-65 frames.
